My kitten underwent a cesarean section due to difficulties during labor. However, upon leaving the surgery, she had severe diarrhea, and the incision was poorly made, causing the wound to reopen. She also contracted an infection due to poor hygiene of the instruments used and the facilities where the procedure was performed (all of this was later explained to me by a veterinarian at another clinic).
Sadly, my kitten passed away three days after the operation due to professional negligence. Before her death, I contacted the specialist at the other clinic when my cat was already in very poor condition and showing no improvement. After examining her and hearing about her progress, she confirmed what I had previously told her and the cause of death.
Today, I spoke with a friend who also took her kitten to Pet Center for a cesarean section. Her cat bled from the genital area for three days after the surgery. She took her back for a checkup, and they sent her back after 24 hours. However, they hadn't examined her or given her any treatment. My friend had to contact a doctor at another clinic for treatment, and it turned out that during the C-section, the incision had been made incorrectly, damaging her bladder, and they hadn't repaired the injury. They closed the other layers of tissue, but ignored the damage they had caused. My friend's kitten had to undergo another emergency surgery to repair her bladder and stop the bleeding.
It makes me so angry that these kinds of establishments offer surgical services when they lack adequate hygiene, proper facilities, and the necessary ethics or professional training.

"LAZY VETERINARIANS" is what I would call them. I'm sharing my TERRIBLE experience from a few days ago, specifically on Monday, October 30th. I called because I wanted to take my kittens in for a checkup. I don't know who the person answering the phone is; they never mentioned their name. Anyway, they scheduled an appointment for me that same day at 7:00 pm. I arrived at that time, and they acted like they didn't know anything about it, saying it was strange because none of their employees scheduled appointments at that time and that no one had called them. In short, they called me a liar. And even though I explained everything, they refused to see my kittens. I've attached evidence of the call. Zero stars if I could!! But I really DO NOT RECOMMEND THEM!!! Or tell me, were my sick kittens to blame for their lack of organization and their laziness in not seeing me?
